label: Broad Cove River coastal mouth
point_definition: Historical single-line river/coast junction, paired with the midpoint of the original two river-bank/coast transitions.
identity_evidence: The labelled Broad Cove River approaches the coast from the south/southeast after its bends through Broad Cove Mines. A separate coastal drainage entry lies northeast, and the shore continues southwest toward the separately drawn McIsaac Pond locality. This ordering matches the original reference network. The selected junction is visible next to, not underneath, the river label. Mouth migration and historical generalization limit precision; no historical permanence or engineering-change bound is asserted.
phase: Fresh independent coastal validation; no fit tuning or promotion
